lines.en: Four short legs, but I dart quickly.
I follow you. Do not leave me behind.

lines.zh: 我的身体比本家小一圈。
lines.en: I am a size smaller than my kin.
My tail passes; the grass discolors.
I move in little hops.
Where you are, I go.

lines.zh: 身上湿湿的，走路带水痕。
lines.en: Damp all over, leaving wet marks.
I run more steadily than I look.
I follow your footprints by scent.
This small body is tougher than it looks.
Shallow pits follow me over sand.
I walk at your heel, saying nothing.
Short legs, so I quicken my step.

lines.zh: 我偶尔停下来看你一眼。
lines.en: Now and then I stop to check on you.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声很轻，像水滴。
lines.en: My steps are light as dripping water.
Go too far and I turn to wait.
I crouch beside you, quiet.
The sacs on my body rise and fall.
This smell will not leave.
I listen to what moves below.
My eyes are cold.
I lick my own claws.

lines.zh: 从培育器出来那天起，我就跟着人。
lines.en: Since the incubator, I have followed people.
The hide on my back feels tight.
I do not fear fire. I fear water.
I circle to find a lee from the wind.
Wind carries my smell away.
I lower my head and freeze.
Better here than the tank.

lines.zh: 我趴在你脚边，连气都不敢喘重。
lines.en: I lie at your feet, barely daring to breathe.
You are the one I follow.

lines.zh: 我仰起脸，只认你这双手。
lines.en: I lift my face; I know only your hands.
Do not walk so fast.
I know your scent.
What are you thinking?

lines.zh: 我把脑袋偏过去，听你的呼吸。
lines.en: I tilt my head to listen to you breathe.

lines.zh: 我这条命是你孵出来的。
lines.en: You hatched me.
I am a bit damp. Forgive it.
I lean in against you.
Are you afraid of me?

lines.zh: 我不会炸开——至少不会对你。
lines.en: I do not burst — not at you, anyway.
A sound rattles in my throat.
I have sheathed my claws.
If you want to pet me, do not hesitate.

lines.zh: 痛呼卡在喉咙里，只一声。
lines.en: A cry jams in my throat, just one.
A new cut in my hide.
I retreat behind you.
I shiver once and steady.
The blood is dark.
I can stand; I am not shaken apart yet.
It hurts, but my hide still holds.
The pain makes me pant.
One of my sacs is dented.
I stare at you and do not retreat.
I know that smell.
For me? Let me sniff.
I take it from your hand.
It is seasoned just right; I can tell.
I chew loudly.
Do not pull back. I do not bite people.
That bite was good.
I lick my lips after eating.
A little more.
Did you keep some for yourself?
I eat fast. Sorry.

lines.zh: 我把它拖到角落里慢慢吃。
lines.en: I drag it to a corner to eat in peace.
I will not eat that.
I look up for more.
Bump me and your foot will hurt.
I step aside.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟碾过我的脚爪。
lines.en: Your heel grinds over my claws.
I am heavier than I look.
Let us go around.
I give a low cry.
Walking this close, we bump.
Your foot is too hasty.
I rub against your leg.

lines.zh: 靠那么近，是想要我护着你？
lines.en: So close — do you want guarding?
I am not grown yet.
That is a long way off.

lines.zh: 我是培育出来的，没有同族。
lines.en: I was grown. I have no kin.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋进前爪，别问了。
lines.en: I bury my face in my forepaws; stop asking.
I would rather follow you.
You do not know what I am.

lines.zh: 喉咙里那声哼，你别当回事。
lines.en: That hum in my throat, pay it no mind.
That is not for me to think about.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转，只想挨近些。
lines.en: I circle against you, only wanting to be near.
Do not bring it up.
I pick it up and bring it to you.
I can carry this.
I dig half of one out of the mud.
I pin it under a paw.
This is for you.
I sniff it. Not poisoned.
I drag it along.

lines.zh: 掉了就再叼，我很有耐心。
lines.en: If it drops, I fetch it again; I am patient.
This one is mine; I tuck it into the grass.
I hide it in the nest.
Someone touched my human.
My back arches.
My hide goes cold.
I am small, but my bite is no weaker.
I stand in front of him.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的气往上顶，我盯住你。
lines.en: Air surges up my throat as I fix my eyes on you.
You should not have come.
I am fixed on your feet.
My body swells a little.
I am harder than a house pet.
I circle you.
I move; you retreat.
I wait for you to open up.

lines.zh: 你每挪半步，我的爪子就跟上。
lines.en: Every half step you take, my claws answer.
Do not turn.

lines.zh: 囊袋鼓起来，我贴地压近。
lines.en: My sac swells as I creep in low.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，爪尖全亮出来。
lines.en: I arch my back and show every claw tip.
There is a wall behind you.
I hum, very softly.
One step more.
I spring and bite.
My claws part your trousers.
I butt your knee.
That bite carries my fumes.

lines.zh: 我咬进你的小腿，带出一口毒气。
lines.en: I bite into your calf and let out a puff of poison.
I fall back to guard my human.
There is a gap in your armor.
One leap puts me on your shoulder.
My tail lashes your face.
Do not follow. I will bite again.
I climb out of the tank.
Slime still clings to me.
The first thing I saw was you.
This ground is very large.
I shake myself out.

lines.zh: 我闻到很多陌生的味道。
lines.en: I smell many strangers.
The incubator glass is broken.

lines.zh: 腿还是软的，我先挪两步。
lines.en: My legs are still soft; I shuffle two steps.
No sea here, and no tank.
I stop at your feet.
Fire blisters my hide.
I land and roll once.
Water is my death.
The blast lifts me off my feet.
An arrow passes through my leg.
That light clenches my sacs.
Hunger drives me wild.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I curl tight.
No ground here for my feet.
